snippet.title: Jumpbound - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Jump and dash your way to the top in this challenging first-person platformer. Embark on an adventure through a mysterious world, unlock more mechanics as you progress, and make every jump count while enjoying the view and relaxing atmosphere.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3448250/Jumpbound

#gaming #indiegame #unrealengine
